ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels and 25% low-intensity dark gray/black pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white regions occupy the distal lateral lobes. Low-intensity dark pigmentation is localized in a central triangular wedge emanating from the notch and extends in a continuous narrow band along the trailing edge and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate 45-degree angle of convergence and high vertical-to-horizontal pixel depth ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular micro-serrations (5-15 pixel amplitude) across the entire boundary, with 3-4 distinct macro-notches (30-50 pixel depth) on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curvature sweeping from the medial notch upward and outward to acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast textured clusters of brownish-white pixels localized at the distal tips of both lobes. Sparse dark circular pockmarks (10-15 pixel diameter) scattered on the high-intensity white surface of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Four distinct dark diagonal linear pixel streaks (rake marks) on the lower-medial quadrant of the right lobe; two faint horizontal linear disruptions on the lower-medial quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy calcified encrustations at the lateral tips; multiple dark linear rake marks on the right ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: White water turbulence/spray occludes the pixel data at the basal insertion point where the fluke meets the water line.
